title: CEDAR-GRPO: Process-Aware Reinforcement Learning for General Abductive Reasoning in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.14791v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Abductive reasoning, often characterized as inference to the best explanation, is central to explanation under uncertainty, from everyday sense-making and investigation to scientific discovery. Yet LLM research has mostly studied abduction through narrow, task-specific benchmarks, making it unclear whether observed gains transfer beyond the benchmark family used for training or evaluation. We ask whether RL post-training can improve abduction as a transferable reasoning capability. We introduce CEDAR-GRPO, a process-aware framework that combines final-answer correctness with abductive rewards for evidence coverage and evidence-to-explanation directionality. Four open-weight LLMs are post-trained on a controlled, domain-neutral mixture of abductive hypothesis-generation and hypothesis-selection tasks. translated_title: CEDAR-GRPO：面向大语言模型通用溯因推理的过程感知强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14791v1 公告类型：新 摘要：溯因推理，通常被描述为对最佳解释的推断，是从日常理解与调查到科学发现等不确定性情境下解释的核心。然而，大语言模型研究大多通过狭窄的、任务特定的基准来研究溯因推理，这使得所观察到的性能提升是否能够超越训练或评估所用的基准家族尚不明确。我们探讨强化学习后训练能否将溯因推理提升为一种可迁移的推理能力。我们引入了CEDAR-GRPO，一个过程感知框架，将最终答案的正确性与针对证据覆盖和证据到解释方向性的溯因奖励相结合。四个开放权重的大语言模型在受控的、领域中性的溯因假设生成和假设选择任务混合集上进行了后训练。我们在跨越假设选择、缺失事实生成、可废止推理、长上下文调查等11个未见任务上对它们进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出CEDAR-GRPO框架，通过结合最终答案正确性与过程感知的溯因奖励（证据覆盖和方向性），在领域中性任务上后训练LLM，从而将溯因推理提升为一种可迁移的通用推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CEDAR-GRPO, a process-aware framework that combines final-answer correctness with abductive rewards for evidence coverage and directionality, post-training LLMs on domain-neutral tasks to improve abductive reasoning as a transferable capability.
